name: Turkey Meatball Traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Mix the turkey mince with the egg, grated onion, herbs, salt and pepper and roll into 12 meatballs.
Chop the potatoes and carrots into bite-sized pieces, toss in the oil on a large baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the meatballs to the tray and roast for 20 minutes more, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Divide between two plates and serve straight from the tray.
